summary.gap_size_scaling: not supported in this model: gate G12 failed (the k=1 wound never arrests; the gap ladder is incomplete) and G8 was not evaluable; the k=4 and k=7 bracket midpoints differing does not by itself refute a constant Phi because their bracket intervals overlap. Counter-evidence kept, criteria not rescued.

gates.note: Counted from results-r2.json: 8 pass, 3 fail, 1 descriptive (G6, 3 seeds of one model, no bound assigned) and 1 unevaluable (G8). The handoff phrase nine of thirteen counted G6 as a pass; it is not.

summary.horizon: CLOSED and ARRESTED are operational labels at a finite 1000 model-unit horizon; permanence of arrest is not shown.

j_scaling.scope: one doubling of interface energy at k=4, one conditional out-of-sample bracket check; 1.414 is the geometric mean of the observed bracket (1, 2), not an observed point threshold; nothing is established at k=7 or for exact proportionality
j_scaling.status: tested model hypothesis, not a law

pair.same: wound, seed and every parameter except motility

passive_floor.reading: Observed in this one context (both drives off, same wound): the gap still shrinks by this fraction as surviving cells relax into volume they were short of (geometric and volume relaxation, with perimeter and Metropolis dynamics). It is a context-specific control, not a universal amount to subtract: show it beside a matched baseline, and no isolated mechanism contribution was measured. The card's separate 25% geometric-floor arithmetic is under review (625 nodes filled versus 1875 residual); no 25% figure is shown here.

readout_check.G1b: logger and TIFF agree at the 21 times they share, of 41 TIFF frames per arm (logger every 10, TIFF every 25: shared at 0, 50, ..., 1000); the other TIFF frames are not compared. Same engine state, so a readout-consistency check, not independent biology. G1 is an identity from the gap definition, not independent area conservation.
